decisions.reason: As a test product it is more uncertain, but in a growing market and with strong fit to the firm's physical-media platform and catalog capabilities, boundedly rational management would likely retain it for another year unless clear underperformance emerges.

This compilation series is very close to the firm's established curated reissue business, so with no visible failure signal and some industry tailwind, management would likely keep it as it appears consistent with aspiration levels and existing resources.
